This apartment's special feature is the sauna. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, this spacious apartment offers a living room and terrace where you can relax. The air-conditioned apartment provides a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a washing machine, Smartphone, a dining area as well as garden views. The unit has 4 beds.
